repo-registry: add semantic file metadata

Upgrade Repo Registry to semantic schema v2.

Adds deterministic semantic metadata for each registry item: module, layer, responsibility, owner, safe_to_edit, runtime_impact, source_priority, and notes. Keeps the agent source-first and cheap: no AI calls, no content reads, no Telegram logic, and no deploy logic.
